_comment: Instants the live calendar feed emits that the committed schedule does not hold. Every entry must say why. See sports-viewer-meta/scripts/smoke-prod.mjs.

feedStartMismatch.why: Match 79 (R32, Azteca) was delayed by weather. src/data/matches.js records the 22:00 EDT start it actually had; ESPN's scoreboard keeps the 21:00 EDT it was scheduled for. The app is right.
Match 92 (R16, Azteca) started an hour late in weather. Committed data holds the 21:00 EDT actual start, ESPN the 20:00 EDT scheduled one.
